# Character Settings Guidelines

- Keep all edits in Japanese and preserve the current plain-text reference style.
- Treat this file as the canonical source for recurring NPC motivations and hidden truths. Scenario edits should follow this file, not silently overwrite it.
- Preserve the layered characterization of シュザンヌ, イヴ・タンギー博士, and エマ. Do not simplify them into single-note archetypes.
- Keep motives, loyalties, and secrets internally consistent. If one fact changes, verify the downstream effect on all three scenarios before editing.
- Preserve the balance between public persona and hidden reality. This is especially important for シュザンヌ's dignity and ambition, イヴの忠誠の向き, and エマの記憶と存在意義.
- Prefer concise additions that clarify intention, relationship, or contradiction. Avoid overexplaining what the scenarios currently leave usefully ambiguous.
- When adding background details, favor details that support scene play, foreshadowing, or emotional payoff elsewhere in the campaign.
